info.title: relink
info.description: URL shortener. Redirects are served at /{code}; links are managed under /v1 with an API key (Authorization: Bearer rlk_...) or, for people, a session from OpenID Connect sign-in. Errors are {"error":{"code","message","request_id"}}.

get.description: The Host header picks the domain: a custom domain a workspace has verified serves its own codes, and any other host the default domain's. A custom domain's settings also apply: / redirects to its root_url, /{prefix}/{code} serves a code behind one of its prefixes, codes ignore case when case_insensitive is set, and its not_found_page and gone_page replace the plain-text 404 and 410 (as text/html, under a Content-Security-Policy that allows no scripts). On the default domain / and two-segment paths are unknown paths.

451.description: Not available in the visitor's country and no fallback URL is set.

503.description: The link is not cached and the database is unavailable, or the host may be a custom domain and the verified domains have not been loaded yet.

get.description: Ready while not shutting down, even when the database is down (cached redirects are still served). The body reports the database state.

get.summary: The OpenAPI description of this API

get.description: Answered on every host while relink is ordering a certificate for that host from its ACME certificate authority, which fetches it over plain HTTP on port 80.

200.description: The key authorization for the token.

404.description: No pending challenge with this token for this host.

503.description: The database could not be asked about a token this instance has not loaded yet.

post.description: Refused with quota_exceeded (403) when the workspace holds as many links as its plan allows or has used its plan's clicks for the current UTC month; see GET /v1/usage. With domain, the code is on that verified custom domain and only needs to be unique there.

get.summary: List the workspace's links, newest first
Get a link in the workspace

patch.description: Only the fields present change. null clears expires_at, max_clicks, geo and fallback_url. Changing destinations resets their health and invalidates A/B assignments.

delete.summary: Delete a link and its statistics

get.description: The workspace's plan, how many links and custom domains it holds and how many clicks it has had in the current UTC month, each with the plan's limit (null for none). Clicks are counted when the click pipeline writes them, so they trail redirects by up to the flush interval. Over a limit, creating links is refused with quota_exceeded; redirects are never refused.

post.description: Adds an unverified domain and returns the TXT record that proves it. Needs the admin or owner role. Refused with quota_exceeded (403) when the workspace holds as many domains as its plan allows (and never more than 1000), already_exists (409) when it already has this hostname.

patch.description: Needs the admin or owner role. Absent fields keep their value; null (an empty list for prefixes, false for case_insensitive) returns one to the default. Turning case_insensitive on while a code on the domain has uppercase letters is refused with failed_precondition (409). Changes reach every instance and the edge like any domain change.

200.description: The domain with its new settings.

delete.description: Needs the admin or owner role. A domain that still has links is refused with failed_precondition (409).

post.summary: Check a custom domain's TXT record now
post.description: Looks up the TXT record at verification.name through the server's DNS resolvers. When it holds verification.value the domain is verified and serves links from then on; otherwise check_error says what was found. Needs the admin or owner role and no body. A hostname another workspace verified first is already_exists (409).

get.summary: Start signing in with the OpenID Connect provider
get.description: Only when RELINK_OIDC_ISSUER is set; 404 otherwise. Stores a pending sign-in, sets the relink_login cookie (10 minutes) and redirects to the provider with an authorization code request using PKCE (S256).

parameters.name: return_to
parameters.description: A path on this server to return to after signing in. Default /v1/auth/session.

get.description: The provider's redirect back. Requires the relink_login cookie to match state, takes the pending sign-in (each completes at most once), exchanges the code and checks the ID token (RS256 or ES256 signature by a provider key, issuer, audience, authorized party, expiry, issue time, nonce). The first sign-in of a person creates them with a member name of their own and a personal workspace they own. Sets the relink_session cookie and redirects to return_to.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Set by the provider when the person declined or the request failed.

get.description: The signed-in person, the session's CSRF token and the workspaces they belong to with their role in each. Not cacheable.

post.description: Ends the session and deletes the cookie. Requires X-CSRF-Token.

Signed-in admins and owners only; API keys are refused with permission_denied. Admins invite editors and viewers, owners any role. Invite by email (accepted by whoever signs in with that address, verified by the provider) or by member name (someone who has signed in before). The answer carries the one-time link (url) and its token, shown only now. At most 100 invitations may be pending at once (quota_exceeded). Audited as invitation.create. Requires X-CSRF-Token.

get.description: Signed-in admins and owners only. Every pending invitation, then the others, newest first, at most 200. Tokens are never shown again.

delete.description: Signed-in admins (for editor and viewer invitations) and owners. Only a pending invitation can be revoked; one already accepted, revoked or expired is already_exists (409). Audited as invitation.revoke. Requires X-CSRF-Token.

get.summary: Look at an invitation before accepting it
get.description: The invitation link. Requires a signed-in person (any). Answers with the workspace and role on offer while the invitation is pending, and not_found saying why otherwise (unknown, expired, accepted or revoked). Changes nothing. Not cacheable.

post.description: Joins the workspace with the invited role. Only the person invited may accept: a verified email address equal to the invited one, or the invited member name; anyone else gets permission_denied. Each invitation is accepted at most once, before it expires and unless revoked (not_found otherwise); someone already a member gets already_exists and the invitation stays usable. Audited as invitation.accept. Requires X-CSRF-Token.

post.summary: Clicks served by the edge worker
post.description: Only present when RELINK_EDGE_TOKEN is set; 404 otherwise. Clicks are validated as strictly as on the origin and queued with them.

get.description: Totals per UTC day and breakdowns by country, device class and referrer host (top 50 each). Unique visitors are per day only: visitor hashes are keyed with a salt that changes daily, so visitors cannot be linked across days.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Default: today (UTC). The range is at most 366 days.

edgeToken.description: The shared secret in RELINK_EDGE_TOKEN, held by the edge worker.

session.name: relink_session
session.description: Set by signing in (GET /v1/auth/login). Acts with the rights of the person's role in the workspace named by Relink-Workspace, or in their personal workspace. Every request other than GET, HEAD and OPTIONS must also send the session's CSRF token (from GET /v1/auth/session) in X-CSRF-Token, or it is refused with permission_denied. When Authorization is present, the API key is used and the cookie ignored.

apiKey.description: rlk_ followed by 64 hex characters, created with `relink create-key OWNER`. A key carries scopes (links:read, links:write, stats:read); each operation lists the one it needs. A key can use a scope only if its owner's role in the workspace grants it: viewers get links:read and stats:read, editors, admins and owners all three. A missing scope or right is 403 permission_denied; an expired key is 401.

Domain.name: domain
Domain.description: The custom domain the code is on; absent for the default domain. A hostname the workspace does not have finds no link.

Workspace.name: Relink-Workspace
Workspace.description: The workspace the request is meant for. An API key acts only in its own workspace, which is the default; naming another is refused with permission_denied. A session acts in the named workspace if the person is a member, else in their personal workspace.

InviteToken.name: token
InviteToken.description: The token from the invitation link. It is a credential: relink never logs it.

Csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
Csrf.description: The session's CSRF token; required on every state-changing request authenticated by the session cookie.

Redirect.description: Redirect to the destination (or the fallback URL). A/B links may set an assignment cookie.

Error.description: An error. Codes: invalid_argument 400, unauthenticated 401, permission_denied 403, quota_exceeded 403 (the workspace is at a plan limit, or has the most pending invitations it may have), not_found 404, method_not_allowed 405, already_exists 409, payload_too_large 413, unsupported_media_type 415, resource_exhausted 429 (with Retry-After), internal 500, unavailable 503 (with Retry-After).

member.description: The person's name in workspace memberships.

url.description: http or https; no credentials; public hosts only unless configured otherwise.

Rule.description: Sends the visitor to url when the condition under if holds. Rules are tried in order and the first that holds wins; when none does, the link's own destinations apply.

url.description: Checked and normalised like a destination.

Condition.description: One key: all, any or not to combine conditions (nested at most 8 deep), or a leaf. A link's rules hold at most 64 leaves in all; a leaf's list holds 1 to 300 values. An unknown visitor attribute never matches a list.

language.description: Language tags such as en or pt-BR; en also matches en-GB. Compared with the visitor's most preferred Accept-Language tag.

referrer.description: Hostnames; a subdomain of a listed host also matches.

query.description: Holds when the query parameter is present or, with values, has one of them (compared after percent-decoding).

TimeWindow.description: Every part given must hold. days and hours are read at utc_offset_minutes.

before.description: Holds until just before this instant; later than after.

hours.description: [start, end): start included, end not. An end before the start wraps midnight; 24:00 may end a window.

CreateLink.description: Give exactly one of url and destinations.

alias.description: Custom code. Reserved words are refused.

fallback_url.description: Used for geo-blocked visitors and when every destination is unhealthy.

domain.description: A custom domain the workspace has verified; absent or null for the default domain.

rules.description: Targeting rules, tried in order. A refused list is invalid_argument with the JSON path of the part at fault, such as rules[1].if.all[0].country[2].
Replaces the whole list; null or [] removes the rules.

domain.description: The custom domain the link is on; null for the default domain.

healthy.description: null when health checks are off.

rules.description: Targeting rules in order, with destinations normalised; [] for none.

day.description: UTC days since the Unix epoch; today, yesterday or tomorrow.

limit.description: null: the plan sets no limit.

InvitationRequest.description: Exactly one of email and member.

email.description: Set when invited by email address (lower case).

member.description: Set when invited by member name.

email.description: Set when invited by email address (lower case).

member.description: Set when invited by member name.

token.description: Shown only in this answer; only its SHA-256 is stored.

url.description: The one-time link to send to the person invited.

period_start.description: First day of the current UTC month.

period_end.description: First day of the next month, when the click meter starts again.

hostname.description: A public hostname such as go.example.com, without scheme, port or path. Stored lowercase with IDNA applied.

verification.description: The DNS record to publish to verify the domain.

check_error.description: Why the last attempt did not verify the domain.

certificate.description: Null until the domain is verified; then its TLS certificate from the ACME certificate authority. Stays pending while RELINK_ACME_DIRECTORY is not set.

status.description: issued once there is a certificate (a failed renewal then shows in error); failed when the last attempt for a first certificate failed.

renew_at.description: Two thirds of the way through its lifetime, when it is renewed.

checked_at.description: The last attempt to issue or renew.

next_attempt_at.description: After a failure, when the next attempt is due.

settings.description: What the domain does besides serving its links; every field is shown, null or empty when unset.

root_url.description: Where / redirects (302). Follows the rules destinations do.

not_found_page.description: HTML for 404: unknown codes, disabled links and paths that are not a code here. {{code}} and {{host}} are replaced, HTML-escaped.

gone_page.description: HTML for 410: expired links and links at their click limit. Same placeholders.

prefixes.description: Path segments accepted in front of a code, so /campaign/abc is the link abc. Stored lowercase; reserved words are refused.

case_insensitive.description: Whether /ABC and /abc are the same link. Links created on the domain then get lowercase codes.

devices.description: desktop, mobile, tablet, bot or other.

referrers.description: Referrer host, or (direct) when there was none.
